verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਹੁ ਮਿਤੀ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਛਡੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਨਿਖਸਮੀ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: jiau bahu mitee vesuaa chhaddai khasam nikhasamee hoiee|

en.bdb: A prostitute having many lovers leaves her husband and thus becomes unclaimed masterless.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤੁ ਜਣੇ ਜੇ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਦਾਦਕਿ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: put jane je vesuaa naanak dhaadhak naau na koiee|

en.bdb: If she gives birth to a son, he carries no maternal or paternal name with hint

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਰਕਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿਆ ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗ ਛਲਿ ਛਲੈ ਛਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: narak savaar seegaariaa raag ra(n)g chhal chhalai chhaloiee|

en.bdb: She is a decorated and ornamental hell which deceives people by loving apparent charm and grace.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘੰਡਾਹੇੜੁ ਅਹੇੜੀਆਂ ਮਾਣਸ ਮਿਰਗ ਵਿਣਾਹੁ ਸਥੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gha(n)ddaaheR aheReeaa(n) maanas mirag vinaahu sathoiee|

en.bdb: As the hunter's pipe attractes the deer, so do the songs of a prostitute allure men to their destruction.

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਥੈ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਾਮ ਹੋਇ ਅਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਢੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: ethai marai haraam hoi agai dharageh milai na ddoiee|

en.bdb: Here in this world she dies an evil death and hereafter obtains no enterance into God's court.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ ਜਾਣ ਰੁਪਈਆ ਮੇਖੀ ਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: dhukheeaa dhusaT dhubaajaraa jaan rupieeaa mekhee soiee|

en.bdb: Similar to her, who adheres not to one person the double-talker cunningly following two religious masters is always unhappy and like a fake rupee is exposed at the counter.
